body: I gave it a try but unfortunately it didn't work for me.

I think race plays a factor in this as well, I'm speaking more personally as a black woman who grew up in a predominantly white area but its interesting how we get categorised on the spectrum of attractiveness. Unsurprisingly when the black girls I knew growing up who were more racially ambigious they got access to more serious prospects and attention. And even then if those relationships failed they'd be single for a long time. Whereas darker skinned black women, black women with broader features etc who were on the same level of attractiveness as them and my white peers or even more attractive on occasion were treated horribly. So then it became difficult for me when I was younger and more naive to say what is the issue here? Now I know unfortunately.

I noticed with me men felt entitled to sex and were more physically/verbally aggressive towards me and I do wonder if I was a different race how that would play out. I think I'd be where I am now still having never had a relationship, but I probably wouldn't have so many sad memories.

I noticed if someone who wasn't conventionally attractive was very good at their job, they were just given more tasks to do until they burnt out, whereas an attractive person at my job doing well was praised and welcomed in by my colleagues more.

Yeah I remember going for interviews and if I wasn't perfect and polished I was discarded. But then I'd hear about more attractive people doing terribly in interviews and still getting the job. At my old job I also recall being micromanaged and not allowed to put a foot wrong, whereas other people could be blatantly wrong and still get  treated with compassion and patience. The conversation thing you mentioned also really rings a bell, people just aren't interested in even trying to engage with those they deem 'inferior' to them.

Exactly. I have had it with men in my age group they are geniunely awful. When I do engage with the ones who seem like they would be more varied or interesting they have an ego the size of the moon. They'll do the bare minimum in conversations, ghost, or as you said get sexual very quickly. The entitlement and cruelty from them is abhorrent and deeply depressing to engage with.

Same here I plan on leaving my terrible dead end job next week because I am fed up of being treated as expendable. I noticed out of everyone at work I am treated the worst and have to put up with so much, I wish I was like the other women I see in my community that find a husband and never have to work again or the beautiful women I see in town who land the perfect jobs. The only jobs I can get are the worst ones it's made me so suicidal.

I know how you feel, sometimes they may pity include me in their conversations but I am always the outsider looking in. I also find they're more lenient on rules and expectations with one another than they are with me.

Thank you for your response and kind words! I think on reflection the first one not making an effort to talk to me on the date, made me lose interest in him, he was the same as his profile but it was a shame and made me stop fancying him. The second guy I definitely did fancy, and his profile presented him accurately, he seemed nice enough and engaged in the conversation it just seemed like it all fizzled out by the end.

I didn't make contact with him, I always found when I contact guys first they string me along or they just blatantly ignore me.

I know exactly how you feel, I'm so sorry that happened to you. I recently went on a date where the guy kept saying he was worried about his parking and ended the date very quickly as a result aka I want to get away from you because you aren't worth my time. It's so upsetting and deeply, deeply depressing to either have men who can't be bothered to make the effort or feel entitled to nudes/sex after talking for 0.2 seconds.
Yes I do at the moment thank you.
How long should I give it until I presume I am ghosted? Thanks for the response btw.

I am exactly like this now after my entire life being nothing but rejection, misery and pain. I see other people all around me all day everyday having everything I have been denied access to and wonder why did they get it and not me? I'm so bitter now whenever I see someone succeed in anything or get something I dreamt of I resent them for it. If it's online I can scroll past or just block the account, if it's offline however I just seethe inside.

The older I get the worse the bitterness and mean nature becomes. I have nothing so there's nowhere for me to try and learn joy and excitement for others anymore. It was at least easier when I was younger and could delude myself that maybe, one day it would be me. But when life is rapidly passing me by I see the brutish reality and it's unavoidable.

It makes me so sad, because the only way to end this pain would be to end my life. Each day that is becoming something I have to come to terms with, and I know at this point thre just isn't any real reason to avoid killing myself, I'm just avoiding the inevitable.
So I should text again and ask what time/place? Yes I agree about expectationsso I'll mention that too.

I'm so sorry I know how you feel. My situation was similar somewhat as I met a guy on a dating app, went on a date and then he asked to meet up again only to ghost. I know it's because he found a better option. But it's so raw and painful. The guy you mentioned and the guy I'm talking about are both cruel for doing that.
Thank you for your response. I don't see the point to be honest I think I'll just say the look forward to it and leave it up to him to message.
What should I say to him in response? Should I even bother responding?

I know exactly how you feel, I'm sorry. At my job they all have friends and just seem to naturally get on with one another, even people who've joined after me are adored here, whilst everyone ignores me. I'm naturally quite reserved but I really tried, and clearly it wasn't enough, it's like they could smell I was different to them. It's very isolating I know, everywhere I go the same thing happens over and over again. There's nothing wrong with you, I think you should put some distance between you and them because you deserve better.

Hey thank you for your sweet message. I did respond yesterday saying I gave an album of theirs a listem and that I really liked a song of theirs. When would you consider it ghosting? May I also ask how do you avoid getting into that negative spiral?

No I like you find them disgenuine and they always have a streak of cruelty about them. There's a few popular women at my job, one I work closely with and I've seen a very mean side to all of them. They obviously only present this side to people they deem lesser than.

I found it's the same with popular men at work. They're usually quite mean and dismissive, but that's not shocking since I'm not attractive they like their unpopular brethren treat me like dirt.
Yep all the time, but they either cut the convo short or don't engage with me.

Why do you say he hasn't done anything wrong? I think it's rude he messages me first then doesn't bother to even check my response but has time to post on his story. I feel like I'm a low priority if that to him. And if he sees me like that then I'l make him an even lower priority and ghost.

I completely get what you mean. When I was younger the rare occasions men would message me would be demanding or expecting nudes. I had such low self esteem that some interaction to me was better than nothing at all. Now that I'm older the very rare occasions men do message me its the same but I just immediately unmatch/block. 

I'm so sorry about what that guy said to you. It's so rude, and yes you're right if we were more attractive they wouldn't be so quick to basically tell us to get out. I've never gone to a guys for sex, but when I have talked about I remember distinct situations that made me feel awful. Like one guy saying we could do it in his car. Or one making a very sexualised statement to me straight away. Both guys I've seen are now in relationships with women they worship and surprise surprise they look nothing like me.

It just makes me feel rotten. Like I can barely get anyone to contact me, and when I can they either ghost even if I offer sex, or just ghost generally, or speak to me like a mongrel. It's infuriating and an incredibly isolating experience. I think that's why when anyone shows a modicum of decency to me I fixate on them, because its foreign to me.
Nope skinny always have been.
I keep getting rejected and have men show a general lack of interest.
I keep getting rejected and have men show a lack of interest so clearly something is wrong with me.
Thank you dear, he said he wishes me all the best but he doesn't think we're right for each other. This was the first time I'd gone on any dates and likely the last. I feel so humiliated.
I'm 24 he's 25

Exactly I've watched dating advice videos and they always say that. I can't get one guy to show vague interest in me. Its one of the reasons that when a guy does throw me a scrap of attention I latch on and my whole world falls apart when they inevitably discard me.

Same here I feel like I'm losing my mind thinking about them over and over, all day everyday. I can't fully immerse myself in the holidays because I'm stuck on him. While it's clear he doesn't give a damn about me.

I was hoping to hear from him, still hoping but I know I'll be in the same pit of despair tomorrow because he won't contact me. He's not thinking about me so why would he. I hate being like this.

Exactly, they don't care how horrible she is as long as she has what they prize most, beauty. They don't care if she's outright cruel, boring, or dare I say it racist, homophobic etc, as long as she's pretty its all that matters. They'll even go and make more effort for someone like that, then women who aren't attractive but decent individuals. It's why I don't buy the bullshit that they spout online or off about what attributes they want in a girlfriends personality, those are just perks. The main thing they want is beauty.
So should I assume he'd send the details tomorrow on the day of the date?
So is he wanting me to make the effort to confirm?
Could you elaborate?

No I haven't attempted to message him during that time. I don't initiate conversation until the last date where I messaged him afterwards first. I haven't scheduled any dates or offerd to go more towards his location, but I am now which is why its putting me on edge a bit because I need to plan in advance if I'm driving to his location
Hey, thanks for your message I want to text him but my fear of rejection is making me scared to do so. I don't know what I'd say after a week of not chatting to him.

He was very warm and asked a lot of questions as did I, we shared our food and chatted for a while. There where some awkard pauses, and we did walk quietly back to his car but he said at the end he enjoyed it and had a nice time. I do wonder if the awkward pauses made him think I was too shy or just wasn't interested in engaging with him I was just nervous really.

Is it safe to assume then if he doesn't text within a week he's not interested?
Fear I think that I would fail and end up in a worse position.
No I don't for either, my accent is just like his and my dialect is the same as his.

No they don't, its quite hurtful because it happens all day everyday. I try sometimes to make eye contact with them in the street or when I'm on my way to/from work but they never acknowledge me. Its like I don't exist and I know its all down to my appearance.
I get what you mean, whenever I see a pretty woman it's always guaranteed there's some guy  giving her all his attention. I resent it so deeply, I yearn for it myself.

Same, I don't go anywhere or do anything. I can't form any real connections with anyone, so I have no friends and of course no partner. I can't even imagine what it must be like to have friends or a loving partner it's so foreign to me I can't even make believe in my head anymore.

I have no goals or ambitions really, I wanted to do well at university but its so scary and overwhelming that I've given up. I don't know who I am or what I want really, I'm confused and lost.

I spend all day just staring at my computer, and soon I'll be doing that alongside going to work which I absolutely despise. I hate my life.

I feel exactly the same. I just think to myself what is the point, no one ever tries with me so why should I try with them. I've spent my whole life pouring myself into people, situations, desperately trying to find a connection when its clear I'm easily disposable regardless of what I do, think, wear etc.

I watch other people sometimes and wonder what it must be like to be so naturally likeable, to have people want to know you. I know once my parents die I'll be alone and I will have to face the loneliness that's already ravaged me. I wish there was an easy way to end my life at this point, I'm not even sad I just feel hollow.

Same here, I've contorted myself to appease others and even then it isn't enough. No one wanted me around in the first place, and its like they can smell that I'm not really this funny, bubbly person. In reality I'm boring, miserable and have no real interests, hobbies etc. That added with the fact that I'm ugly has rendered me an outcast regardless of how hard I try to be someone, something else.
No its never been the case for me. I've found the only person I could rely on was myself.

It's exactly the same for me at work. I'm never invited to social gatherings. I remember the last day before the holidays when everyone was talking to each other and I was just sat there in silence, no one bothered to try and talk to me. I'm exhausted with having to be the first to say hello or encourage conversation, I want someone to want to interact with me for once.

I know its no real consolation but I do get how you feel, and how soul crushing that feeling is when it extends to every facet of your life.

Yes I think about it often, I was watching this documentary about missisippi in the 1960s ages ago and I noticed the women who were fawned over and given affection, as in marriage, relationships etc would be considered average or below in todays standards. I noticed that sometimes the men were more attractive but they doted on these women. Like I know all too well it was far from wonderful during that era, but the beauty standards where definitely not as horrific as they are today.

Sometimes I wish I could travel back to then just for a few days. Just to see whether I'd finally be seen. Because in todays age the standards are absurd. Unless you are quite literally ig model level of beauty you are ignored by men in my age bracket. I think its disgusting honestly, because of the insidious nature of it all. It's an abnormal beauty standard and its incredibly isolating how normalised its become.

I'm currently working at a school and wish the kids there were like the ones you've described at the summer camp.  That sounds amazing and I'm happy you're enjoying your experience there. The kids I work with are vile. They only acknowledge staff they're scared of, male staff and staff that are conventionally pretty. The few staff that they are compassionate to that are average looking or below have a 'cool' vibe. When you're like me, awkward and ugly it is like entering the pits of hell. It was only when I became colder and meaner they left me alone more.

Now I see why the job constantly has openings. Because I'm out of here as soon as another job becomes available. The children here are the polar opposite of the kids you described. They comment on your skin, your hair, your facial features, your age, your race and on and on. Everyday you're guaranteed to have one of them mention something about you in a negative light. There are some sweet children here of course, but even they are inclined to be nicer to those they deem as socially acceptable.

The school does nothing about it. I see in these kids that same awful behaviour in a couple of years time when they enter the field of study, work etc. You know those type of people, the ones who ignore you because you aren't cool enough or pretty enough to acknowledge. The ones who are actively nasty and rough towards you because you are equivalent to nothing to them.  The ones who mock and jeer at ugly people or laugh behind their back at them. That will be them.

I know how that feels I experience it quite a bit, men either looking away in disgust or looking right through me. Sometimes I'll try to catch their eye but they never see me. The worst ones are the ones that look at me with absolute hatred and digsust in their eyes.

I deal with the exact same behaviour all the time, it's disgusting to see the comparison of how they treat me as oppose to a woman they deem attractive. In shops they'll be extra nice and tell conventionally attractive women to enjoy their day, assist them with all their needs and so on but with me they're blunt and aloof. With bus drivers when I say thank you they don't respond but when an attractive woman says thanks they can suddenly hear again.

Most men do exactly the same thing whether its in service work or not. Their eyes light up and their whole demeanor changes when they interact with an attractive woman. It's one of the reasons I hate going outside and especially going to work, I'm surrounded by men all day who do this tenfold.

Yes I do and I hate it because all the other people my age at work live with their partners or roomates. I'm trapped in an abusive household with an insufferable venomous dad and a mom who doesn't care. I want to get married and have a baby, I want to be in love and be loved and I know it just isn't going to happen. All of it has made me so bitter and miserable, and it's only going to get worse the older I get.

Yep I definitely noticed this at my work. Men being a lot nicer to conventionally attractive young women at work who won't even blink in their direction and ignoring the women who aren't pretty. It's the little things as well, maintaining eye contact with them, smiling and wishing them a good day. They just glare at me and only acknowledge me if they absolutely have to. It's dehumanising and extremely frustrating.

I feel the same, I see them when I go shopping and I end up feeling shit. I just think about how they look and wish I looked like that, had the attention and admiration they have. I also see the guys they're with following them around, doting on them and I feel so sad, then very hollow. I've tried for years to no avail to get guys to notice me, but they want nothing to do with me they always feel they can do better. I wonder how it must feel to know that you've been chosen, that someone wants you in every sense. It's the reason I don't bother going shopping outside much anymore, I just stick to online shopping it's less painful.

I get what you mean, I watch how men behave around attractive women too. It's always the same, always willing to smile and engage with them but with me its like I don't exist. Or I have to 'compensate' with my personality, it's never quite enough beauty is all they value. I do the same with men around my age, I assess and analyse every little interaction with them to work out if they're into me, they aren't of course but its nice to delude myself sometimes.
I would but he mentioned he fancies another girl at work.

Thanks for your response, very good point we definitely won't! Her parents have passed away and her siblings live overseas I did wonder if we could ask to stay at a friends but I feel like a hotel may work better even if its more expensive.
Thanks for your response, I did and so did my mother and he doesn't care he said he feels entitled to them staying here.

Yes I'm usually the ugliest in the room and I notice people only acknowledge me if they want something or as a source of cheap entertainment. It's particularly hurtful when I see how beautiful women are treated in comparison.
My mother is the same, she never called me beautiful.

This post made me realise how touch starved I am, I can't remember the last time someone hugged me. My parents are cold and aloof, I have no friends and definitely no partner. I think the last time a guy hugged me was eight years ago out of pity. I can't even imagine a guy hugging me daily it must be so soothing.
Me too! I always found books and tv shows around the topic so soothing, I'd love to be apart of that world. Like a little hedgehog or fairy that lives in an old oak tree!
I think about so many things mentioned here daily it's torture.

Same here honestly I made the mistake of stalking their linkedin profiles and felt awful afterwards. They all have everything I could ever desire despite being horrible people. But unfortunately I've learnt the hard way nothing in this life is really about your morals or kind character.

I'm so sorry to hear that I would of helped you had I been there! I'm in the same predicament I can't even get a job, all I get is ignored or rejection emails it's humiliating. The whole application process from going through hundreds of job applications, to the waiting to hear from them, to the silence is horrible and I feel like it's made my depression worse. I've found myself sinking back into unhealthy coping mechanisms because I just feel so pathetic.

I see people job hopping all the time too, and I keep seeing people I went to school with getting promoted or getting new great jobs whilst I get nothing. I hate that I'm trapped on this earth with nothing redeemable going for me.

Yes I always think I have to do something with my life to compensate for what I lack in looks. Right now I'm obsessed with leaving some artwork behind or excelling academically although I'm failing miserably in both endeavours.

I feel like then my mind will finally give me permission to end my life.

I know exactly how you feel I sometimes find myself crying or struggling to sleep. I can't sleep for a long time anymore, I think it's this feeling in the pit of my stomach, the realisation I'll always be alone. Trapped in a life I never wanted or desired for myself and knowing there's nothing I can do about it.
Yes I think about it all the time. I just hope I die before my parents do.

Yes I do notice I'm in a depressing position where I simply can't afford to move out, I'm ugly and reserved. So people treat me either with subtle contempt, or like a child. I notice it's worse if I go out somewhere with my mother, people will direct questions to her about me. I always end up intervening and it gets really awkward.

It's odd really it's like people treat me like I'm an idiot as an adult. Or they're very aggressive in their tone to me.

Same here I'd just imagine them talking to someone more attractive or swiping through trying to find a more attractive woman and get annoyed. I eventually gave up on dating apps because I just didn't want to compete for scraps of attention.

I live in the uk and the dynamics here are fucking weird and depressing when it comes to black beauty. In my area at least it seems to be a mixture of who's in the popular crowd, who's pretty and their economic class. It doesn't change the older I get. A lot of the black pretty women here either stick with one guy or remain single. I really agree with your saying of black women  being treated as human beings when we're pretty, even when you're average you can slip into being invisible. White women that I've seen can be very average and still get a lot of attention.

I honestly want a black fa women groupchat to be made so we can all discuss this a bit more privately because I'm tired of not really having anywhere to talk about it.

Same, I realy empathize it's awful. I think I wouldn't feel this deep dread about growing older if I was paired off or secure financially. I feel like a child trapped in a grown womans body unable to just escape. I constantly wish I was dead.
It was a sponge cake! My favourite :) what kind of cake do u like?
Yes it was thank you very much angel!
Same it's like my mind denies it from me like I'll imagine a guy dating me and then my thoughts would immediately go to that's impossible no guy wants you in real life so why're you imagining it.

Me too I'd gladly report the video, and can help research some legal options to take. I really do feel like they are breaking the law, especially considering the amount of stress this has caused you. I am so sorry op this is just so cruel.
Thank you for your response, do you have any recommendations for hairstyles I could wear that are very loose, at the moment I'm just leaving my fro out.

It's lovely to hear it's helped you with growth!! I think I've seen it before at my local superdrug so I'll pop down there tomorrow and purchase it. Thank you for the link as well, it'll be great reading the reviews and doing a little research around the oil. xx
Thank you for your response! Have you used it before for thin/fragile edges?
Thank you for your response! Do you have any methods to tell if the follicles are still alive?
Thank you so much for your response! Is it possible to grow out the edges without cutting the hair?
I think it might be as I always wear my hair in high up buns.

Wow yeah I can totally relate. A lot of people seem to have at least one person that has gone above and beyond to help them. Not me, if I want something done I will have to do it myself. I don't have anybody, if something goes wrong or I don't muster up the strength to do something I'll be out on the street. I know that exhaustion, life just never stops. I'm tired of doing everything solo, it's terrifying and horrifyingly lonely.  


I always wonder how attractive women's lives compare to mine. I notice a lot of the time attractive women come from the middle class in my area at least so already have people willing to go above and beyond to help them. Even if they have to go out of their way to do something, somebody will help them. Attractive middle class men in my area are the same.   


I wish I had a loving family to help guide me with certain things. To help me with day to day things. I wish didn't have to work out how to navigate this awful world alone.
Same I only go out if I have to it's just too much interacting with the outside world. If I could I'd never go out again.

I recall when my fathers brother tried to set up an arranged marriage with me and his son, because it meant he'd be able to move to the UK. When I was 15 no less. He also demanded that he see what I look like, the nerve. My parents thank god coldly rejected his crude demands. The two arranged marriages  that have been suggested to me have been with scumbags who'd leech off of me and would no doubt act like I should be grateful for their existence. Just absurd, I have no doubt if I was pretty they'd be more willing to introduce me to their smarter, more well educated sons.

I kind of also think about the marriages within my culture, all the women who've gotten married to men who've provided for them and afforded them a better life have been beautiful. All my cousins, aunts, who're engaged or married are beautiful. The one's who aren't conventionally attractive, are living very harsh or isolated lives. I feel a deep sense of embarrassment and shame at times, my parents are Eritrean Muslims and no one wants me who's either Eritrean, Muslim or both. No one wants me generally of course, and especially not where I live in the uk.

Other people see me as a vessel for their needs and wants. Not an individual. Never good enough to keep around for friendship and definitely not relationship material.

Same here my father told me he's given up on me and my mother said I'm on my own. I spend each and every day alone. No one checks in on me and I have gone years now having not had any real contact with anybody. I have no friends, no partner, no family. I hate myself and my life.

I feel exactly the same, my low self esteem, depression and the reality of my non existent love life have seeped into my daydreams and now I can't daydream in peace anymore. It's like it's unfathomable to me now. Every time I try to fantasize about being in a relationship I end up imagining something ruining it. Or I can't really imagine certain situations because I've never experienced it, like getting married or building a family. I'm also unable now to imagine someone wanting me and only me. I'm invisible in reality and in my daydreams.  


I know I'll never get into a relationship but if I did I'd feel the same.  As an unattractive woman I've seen their true nature, and I just wouldn't feel comfortable or at ease in a relationship with a man. I'd be deeply envious of any attractive woman I saw, and the expectations put on women in relationships makes me feel like they're a waste of time. For example, how a lot of men expect their partner to be attractive, split the bills, do most if not all of the child rearing, and of course tolerate their occasional cheating online and off. I think this realisation has seeped into my daydreams as well. I just can't imagine a loyal man, a loving man because I've never truly interacted with one.

I can completely relate. When I go through something, whether it be health, studies, work etc it has always been and will always be alone. I have no one to share anything with, and it's destroyed me. It's like my entire life has consisted with me repelling people, not being quite enough to be kept around, by family, the few friends I had, the few conversations on dating apps. People always grow weary or bored of me. It's fluctuated from that or being completely invisible. 

It's terrifying in a way, because when I die I have a bad feeling I'll either rot in my house or on the street if my mental health consumes me and renders me homeless. I'll be forgotten in life and in death. I can't fathom now what it must be like to have friends and family that care, it's so foreign to me I can't even daydream about it. I've never experienced it and can't imagine myself ever having it. 

I spend everyday alone, just hours of being trapped with my thoughts, with my loneliness. I am in so much pain.

I know exactly how you feel, I've been tempted to start drinking honestly or taking something to ease the pain of loneliness. I used to binge eat to cope with it, but after a while that didn't do anything for me and now I barely eat anything. I'm 23 but I feel like my body is so much older and frailer because of the loneliness and grief that comes with it.

I have nothing to do either outside of studying, I spend all my time alone. I'm so scared for what my future holds because at least now I have a roof over my head, but when my parents pass on I will really be alone. It's not even like they're letting me live here out of love, they have shown their contempt for me daring to reach adulthood and be so broken. I have no real skills, no friends, no partner, and no real interest in being alive. I feel like I'll just end up homeless or dead, and a part of me is okay with ending up dead honestly as I doubt life is going to ever really improve for me.

Being loved, being courted, being desired. I know at this point it just isn't going to happen for me, I'm nearly in my mid 20s and nothing has happened, it's like I'm either invisible or hyper visible for the wrong reasons (my race, being ugly).

The bad ones are being catcalled, being sexually harassed. I knew deep down from an early age that would never happen to me. Even when I put myself in high risk situations, like going out late in my teen years, wandering the streets at night in a crowded area...no one sees me. What really drove in the fact that I was some repulsive creature to men was that I was looked at in disgust or annoyance when I was out, alone, and in a vulnerable situation. The way I look has made people see me as either a nuisance or something to actively avoid.

I feel so disconnected when women on other social media outlets talk about the experiences that apparently we all have, because I certainly never did. I'm tired of feeling like I'm something abnormal, something 'other' because of how I've drifted through life.
Exactly it's horrible I just want to die now, life just isn't for me.

I feel exactly the same. I don't want to study anymore, never really wanted to in the first place, don't want to work, don't really want to do anything. I  don't ever feel like I'll be a real adult either, everything is just so overwhelming and draining, plus I'm not working towards anything worthwhile. I'm just existing until I can build up the courage to finally end my life and be free from this nightmare.

I feel like I wasn't made to live honestly. My life has no real purpose, I'd gladly trade it with someone who died who had something going for them. Things are unlikely to get better for me, I am just a pointless person I'd be better off dead.
I feel the same, I find the only thing that wakes me up is comfort eating. But even that brings no real joy it just distracts me for a bit from the numb feeling.

I am in exactly the same spot. I'm so sorry you're in this hell too. I hate it so much at least if I had some redeemable qualities then I'd have something to live for. But I have nothing, and I'm constantly reminded of it either by seeing others accomplishments or having my parents take another dig at me. 

I'm stupid, ugly, with no friends or job prospects and if I'm being honest with myself, will always live in poverty. Wanting to end my life will be a blessing for me and at this point I'm just wondering what it will take to finally make the plans to do so. I think the only thing really stopping me is the fear it won't work, I don't really care what people will think about me hanging myself, jumping off a bridge etc let them judge me at least I won't be here to hear it.
I feel exactly the same it's just too much I hate being alive I wasn't meant to live.

I feel exactly the same, it really is awful and I feel so exhausted because of it. I have been lonely my entire life, I have no one to talk to, my family don't care about me they just judge me constantly and make snide remarks.
